title: Full-prime cohomology, complete support and mixed Weil evaluation

programme_use.purpose: Construct arithmetic cohomology on the full support-prime space and obtain the actual prime-degree operator before evaluating its Weil receiver.
programme_use.advance: Relative principal parts Q/Z with all p-primary components, nonsplit adelic-face extension, exact degree-p local energy and a local complex weight-one norm identity.
programme_use.unproved: Global interior compact-support-to-ordinary cohomology image, its purity, full Weil positivity and RH.

programme_use.purpose: Recover full additive and mixed support lost by observation on the separate branches.
programme_use.advance: Full additive support jet and extensions of ST4, supported cohomology, exact fibre-groupoid maps and joint mixed-support recovery.
programme_use.unproved: A forced analytic-trace identification, a Deligne equivalence or an RH conclusion.

programme_use.purpose: Apply the actual degree-p operator to admissible mixed tests and evaluate their full Weil form, including the Archimedean contribution.
programme_use.advance: The entire distinct-prime three-pulse family has Q(g) > (5981/52500)N > N/10 for all four signs; the signed joint trace remains negative at every r >= 2; the original companion has an injective annulus-distribution map with explicit nonzero boundary.
programme_use.changes_earlier_reading: The negative partial/mixed sign is not a full-Weil counterexample. Use the complete FWP evaluation together with PME and FWJ, and retain the exact distributional target of SBT.
programme_use.unproved: General full Weil positivity, canonical global interior-cohomology identification and an RH decision.

source_of_mathematical_claims: Complete sealed owner proofs and dated results at the linked exact source commit; publisher supplies links and publication verification, not a new proof audit.
